capabilities: Render a 3D interactive word sphere of high-frequency words in the mobile file explorer
Tap floating words to reveal context and jump to the source notes
Scope the analysis to selected folders and a recent time window with auto refresh
Block unwanted words with a tag-style stop-word list
extras: Explicit warning that desktop/iPad users must not install this mobile version and should use the separate Thought Synapse (Desktop) release; the listing has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is via BRAT or manual file download.
problem: Obsidian mobile offers no ambient, touch-friendly visualization of recent high-frequency vocabulary and the notes those words come from.

relations.evidence: please DO NOT install this version. Instead, get the exclusive desktop release
Install Obsidian42 - BRAT from the Community Plugins.

summary: Mobile-only plugin that renders a touch-interactive 3D word cloud of high-frequency words from recent notes, with tap-to-jump links to source notes.
